ChatGPTREADMEWorking Set:
The working set consists of a JavaScript file (getRepoInfo.js) which provides a single function getRepoInfo that extracts information from a Git repository and the package.json file. This function returns a structure containing details like the Git URL, branch, package name, description, tags, and working directory.Task:
We are tasked with updating this functionality such that when there's no package.json file, the name of the project is inferred from the Git repo URL. For example, if the URL is https://github.com/user/repo-name.git, then the name of the project will be repo-name.Challenges:We have to detect if package.json doesn't exist and only then derive the project name from the Git repo URL.Parsing the Git repo URL correctly to extract the project name is crucial.[CODE_BLOCK_0]
